---
title: "Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

```{python}
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

The following dataset will include the dataset of Bond films from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())`
to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (musd)")
plt.show()
```
